title: 7000: Fix mindmap rendering issue when Level 2 nodes exceed 11
description:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

This PR fixes an issue where mindmap Level 2 nodes beyond the 11th rendered incorrectly.  
Affected nodes appeared in black and were disconnected from the graph
Resolves #7000
